data:
unsolved goals
d : ℕ
A : ElectromagneticPotential d
𝓕 : FreeSpace
hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A.val
J : LorentzCurrentDensity d
hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J
h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J
t : Time
x : Space d
i : Fin d
⊢ ∂ₜ (∂ₜ fun x_1 => (electricField 𝓕.c A x_1 x).ofLp i) t =
    𝓕.c.val ^ 2 * ∑ x_1, Space.deriv x_1 (Space.deriv x_1 fun x => (electricField 𝓕.c A t x).ofLp i) x -
        𝓕.c.val ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * Space.deriv i (fun x => LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity 𝓕.c J t x) x -
      𝓕.c.val ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (fun x_1 => (LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity 𝓕.c J x_1 x).ofLp i) t
